responses.situationEnglish: You bought a phone at a small shop yesterday and the screen already flickers. Ask the shop clerk to fix the problem.
responses.learnerGoal: Get a replacement or a refund for the faulty phone.
responses.complication: The shop's policy says no refunds after 24 hours.
responses.hiddenGoal: The clerk needs the original receipt and will offer a same-day replacement if you ask politely.
